WITH statins AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        (1545958,'atorvastatin'),(1549686,'fluvastatin'),(1592085,'lovastatin'),(40165636,'pitavastatin'),
        (1551860,'pravastatin'),(1510813,'rosuvastatin'),(1539403,'simvastatin')
    ) v(ingredient_concept_id, statin)
), statin_drugs AS (
    SELECT s.statin, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
    FROM statins s
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = s.ingredient_concept_id
), first_exposure AS (
    SELECT person_id, statin, MIN(drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN statin_drugs sd ON sd.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY person_id, statin
), myopathy_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4345578,73001,1077352,36713056,37204042)
    UNION SELECT 4345578 UNION SELECT 73001 UNION SELECT 1077352 UNION SELECT 36713056 UNION SELECT 37204042
), outcomes AS (
    SELECT fe.person_id, fe.statin, fe.index_date,
           MAX(CASE WHEN co.condition_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS myopathy_30d,
           MAX(CASE WHEN m.measurement_id IS NOT NULL AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ck_test_30d,
           MAX(CASE WHEN m.measurement_id IS NOT NULL AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL AND (
                    (m.range_high IS NOT NULL AND m.value_as_number > m.range_high)
                    OR (m.range_high IS NULL AND m.value_as_number >= 1000)
               ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ck_spike_30d,
           MAX(CASE WHEN m.measurement_id IS NOT NULL AND m.value_as_number >= 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ck_ge_1000_30d,
           MAX(m.value_as_number) AS max_ck_30d
    FROM first_exposure fe
    LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
      ON co.person_id = fe.person_id
     AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT condition_concept_id FROM myopathy_concepts)
     AND co.condition_start_date >= fe.index_date
     AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 31, fe.index_date)
    LEFT JOIN omop.measurement m
      ON m.person_id = fe.person_id
     AND m.measurement_concept_id = 3007220
     AND m.measurement_date >= fe.index_date
     AND m.measurement_date < DATEADD(day, 31, fe.index_date)
    GROUP BY fe.person_id, fe.statin, fe.index_date
)
SELECT statin,
       COUNT(*) AS new_user_person_statin_cohorts,
       SUM(myopathy_30d) AS myopathy_30d_n,
       CAST(1000.0*SUM(myopathy_30d)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(10,3)) AS myopathy_per_1000,
       SUM(ck_test_30d) AS ck_tested_30d_n,
       SUM(ck_spike_30d) AS ck_spike_30d_n,
       CAST(1000.0*SUM(ck_spike_30d)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(10,3)) AS ck_spike_per_1000_all,
       CAST(CASE WHEN SUM(ck_test_30d)>0 THEN 1000.0*SUM(ck_spike_30d)/SUM(ck_test_30d) END AS decimal(10,3)) AS ck_spike_per_1000_tested,
       SUM(ck_ge_1000_30d) AS ck_ge_1000_30d_n,
       CAST(1000.0*SUM(ck_ge_1000_30d)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(10,3)) AS ck_ge_1000_per_1000_all
FROM outcomes
GROUP BY statin
ORDER BY myopathy_per_1000 ASC, ck_spike_per_1000_all ASC;
